cases.description: Calculate an invoice for non-cancelled rows. Rates are fractions in [0,1]. Subtract the rounded discount from subtotal before tax; total equals discounted taxable amount plus rounded tax. Keep input rows unchanged and preserve helper behavior.

Apply credits and debits to an opening balance, once per event ID. Ignore unsupported kinds without marking them seen. Return sorted seen IDs and a new state, leaving caller state/events unchanged. Multiple accepted events accumulate, including repeated calls.

Adapt an already-decoded API response; no network calls. On status 200 return its items and exact next_cursor, including empty string or None, and mark complete iff next_cursor is empty or None. On 429 retain prior cursor, empty rows, retry true; other errors retain prior cursor with retry false. Never mutate inputs.

Group readings by stripped case-insensitive sensor name. Ignore None readings but preserve numeric zero. Return each group mean from its valid readings only; groups with no valid readings map to None. Keep caller records unchanged.

Retry only HTTP 429 and 503. Use numeric Retry-After seconds when valid, otherwise base * 2**attempt. Clamp the delay to [0,max_delay]. Successful and permanent-failure statuses do not retry. This function does not sleep or perform I/O.

Allocate stock to requests in order without overselling or using reserved stock. Nonpositive requests receive zero. Each allocation reduces remaining available units. Preserve input requests and the nonnegative available_units helper.

provenance: LeftSock authored Phase14; no reference patches; exposed development tests
